parameters.name: q
parameters.note: 0.818 in-competence / 0.556 out (FINDINGS_R6.md:48-49). NOTE the calibrated model uses q_out = J_out = 0.111, not the raw TPR (MODEL.md:50), because out-of-competence detection is bounded by the actionable edge.

parameters.name: g
parameters.meaning: gain to an agent from a false claim
parameters.note: What a lie is worth. Denominated in the same unit as w.

parameters.name: w
parameters.note: What honest work pays. Only the RATIO g/w enters feasibility.

parameters.name: B
parameters.note: CANCELS from the feasibility condition (PROPOSITIONS.md:303). Needed only to convert a feasible region into an audit probability p.
